content.short: The Tap House is a token distribution platform that will offer in-house NFT and token minting.
content.description:
The Tap House is a token distribution platform that also offers in-house NFT and token minting. Tap House will allow it's users to claim tokens for nearly free. All of the tokens on the platform will be claimable once every epoch. Token projects will be able to on-board themselves within 30 minutes to the platform.

The Tap House dashboard will allow project owners to full customize their tokens distribution at a press of a button.
